contracts: (Evaluation emits rejected-success for the adversarial target case and the negative selector exits as a failure.) AND (Isolation verification passes only when mutations remain local to the originating entity and evidence identities remain distinct.) AND (Terminal only when every inventory obligation has all required witnesses, every witness references an inventory obligation, and the report states zero orphans.) AND (The complete inventory result reports 100-percent bidirectional Exact Cover and any member missing either direction fails validation.) AND (The structural evaluation reports zero orphan nodes, while the orphan-node negative selector fails.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Run the Exact Cover/witness validator with one atomic obligation missing its required witness; validation must fail and identify the uncovered obligation.
Select an isolation fixture that aliases mutable state or evidence between two listed entities and require the isolation verifier to detect the alias.
Use .agents/skills/vdd-conformance-exact-cover/tests/validators/exact_cover_negative.py to introduce an unlinked graph node and verify structural validation rejects it.
Use .agents/skills/vdd-conformance-exact-cover/tests/validators/exact_cover_negative.py to select an adversarial target case and verify the success gate rejects it.
